name: Collagen peptides (hydrolyzed)

review.note: Marine (fish-derived) collagen is the assumed default source since bovine collagen is a separate sourcing/suitability question (halal/kosher/vegetarian status) not yet resolved - reviewer should confirm which source(s) this record should represent, and whether bovine collagen needs its own ingredient record instead of an allergen-only distinction.

notes: Candidate ingredient drafted from master research list v2 (2026-09-05), not yet expert-reviewed. Of the outcome domains studied (body composition, collagen synthesis, muscle soreness, joint pain/function), joint pain/functionality was the most consistent finding - evidence tier modeled here as Moderate rather than Limited on that basis.
